checks.check: ORDERING per EPISODE on QUANTITY (400 randomised episodes)
checks.detail: 0 episodes where ProbQueue filled LESS than RiskAverse. The ordering is arithmetic on quantity -- RiskAverse fills only once front reaches 0, and at front = 0 ProbQueue's probability is 1

checks.check: R-570(B) SHARPENED: per-episode COST can invert with no defect
checks.detail: an episode whose mid ran AWAY over T_p costs -6.0 chased against 1.0 filled -- filling MORE costs MORE, so a per-episode cost inversion is the winner's curse, not an implementation defect. This is why the arithmetic check is on quantity.
